Monthly event in which you help a cursed pirate free his soul by sailing a ghost ship across the oceans of the afterlife. You collect {creature:Spectral Scum|Spectral Scums} in the cities, form a crew of 4 players with the same soul mark and keep the ship intact for 5 minutes. Each successful trip gives 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and a {item:Pirate Bag}, and there are 4 achievements to earn.

Help a cursed pirate on his desperate voyage that may free his soul once and for all. Join forces with old and new friends, brought together by fate and the stars, to form a crew and sail the ghostly oceans of the beyond, with all their dangers.

The event doesn't start if another World Event is active or about to begin on the same day. If {wiki:A Piece of Cake|A Piece of Cake} or {wiki:Bewitched|Bewitched} are active under those conditions, the event can also take place in February or June, respectively.
Split up the tasks before boarding: 1 player on the upper deck, the **fastest** player on the middle deck and 2 players on the lower deck.
Players below level 60 should use {spell:Haste}, {item:Time Ring} and speed gear for the middle deck.
Keep the {item:Ghost Duster} and the {item:Emergency Kit} from previous journeys: with spares, the two lower-deck players can do both tasks.
1. Get the soul mark and the Scum Bag

Go to {npc:Smaralda}, southwest of Thais, just **south** of the lighthouse (the {wiki:Thais Lighthouse} is southwest of the Thais depot: walk there from the temple or the depot). Say {key:hi}, ask for a {key:soul seeing} and agree to join the captain's crew. She gives you a **soul mark**.

There are 5 possible soul marks: **Arrow**, **Rock**, **Rope**, **Rune** and **Torch**. If you forget yours, ask Smaralda for {key:soul seeing} again or step on the {item:Glowing Switch|Glowing Switches} inside her house.
Say {key:join} to Smaralda to receive the {item:Scum Bag}.
If you lose the Scum Bag, say {key:trade} to Smaralda and buy another for 500 gp.

The {creature:Spectral Scum|Spectral Scums} attack Thais, Carlin, Ab'Dendriel and Liberty Bay **every 2 hours**, counting from the {wiki:Server Save|Server Save}. Go to one of these cities when the raid happens.
**Use** the {item:Scum Bag} on a Spectral Scum to catch it. Repeat until you have caught 5: you get a message when the bag is full.
A {item:Dwarven Ring} or a {item:Stealth Ring} helps while you chase the pirates.
With the bag full, go back to {npc:Smaralda} and say {key:join}.
Find **3 players with the same soul mark** as you (who have also handed in their 5 Spectral Scums).
All 4 players use the {item:Crystal Ball} inside Smaralda's house. You are teleported to another room.

All 4 players stand on the {item:Glowing Switch|Glowing Switches} and one uses the {item:Lever|lever}. You are all teleported to the ghost ship. You don't need a boat: the ghost ship can only be reached through this teleport.
You have **2 minutes** to get to your deck before the journey begins. The journey lasts **5 minutes**. The ship starts with **40 hit points**; if it reaches zero, you fail.
Holes made by the rats (lower deck)
Ship Core with no health (upper deck)
Put the fastest player on the middle deck.

When the journey ends (after the 5 minutes, or earlier if the ship runs out of hit points) you are removed from the ship: there is no exit of your own on board. The wiki doesn't state the exact place where you appear. For another journey, go back to {npc:Smaralda}'s house, by the Thais lighthouse, and repeat the crystal ball and lever with the crew.
Kill the bats using the **telescope** that matches each one.
Killing a bat with the telescope

**Don't kill** the {creature:Soul Spark}. Keep it close to the {item:Ship Core}: it heals it continuously and prevents the damage to the ship coming from the Ship Core. You can trap it next to the Ship Core with {item:Fire Wall|Fire Walls} and/or {item:Fire Field|Fire Fields}.
A Soul Spark healing the Ship Core
Soul Spark trapped next to the Ship Core
If you kill the Soul Spark or the Ship Core runs out of health, the ship takes a lot of damage.
Charge up at the purple flame

Two minutes after the team boards the ship, a **purple flame** appears in the **west** corner. Step on the wooden floor to the **right** of it and you become charged with **Fire**, **Energy** or **Earth**.

Run to the shrine of the element you are charged with and **use it**. Then go back to the purple flame and repeat, over and over, until the journey ends. Each correct shrine gives the purple flame more life.
If you take too long, the purple flame turns into a grey {item:Poison Field} for a while and the ship loses 10 hit points. You can keep going, unless you get teleported out.

While you are charged, **don't step on** the Spectral Vortexes ({item:Water Vortex|water vortexes}) or the iron floors ({item:Rock (Grate)|grates}). You lose the charge and have to go back to the purple flame, which costs you time. Concentrate on not stepping on the wrong floors instead of running blindly.
Floors you must not step on
A {item:Dwarven Ring} helps if you step on the wrong tiles.
{creature:Sloth Wraith|Sloth Wraiths} appear and can paralyse you. Lure them onto a Spectral Vortex and they disappear.

Some people prefer to wait **70 seconds** after boarding the ship and place {item:Fire Field|Fire Fields} on all the Spectral Vortexes and iron floors. Then use markers on the map to go from the purple flame (west) to the shrines when needed.
In the **northeast** corner of the lower deck you find the {item:Ghost Duster} and the {item:Emergency Kit}.
Kill the rats and plug the holes
{creature:Ghost Rat|Ghost Rats} appear and gnaw holes in the ship. One player uses the {item:Ghost Duster} to kill the rats and the other plugs the holes with the {item:Emergency Kit}.

The rats flee from players and can make you drunk, but they can't see invisible players. Ideally both of you use a {item:Stealth Ring} or the {spell:Invisible} spell (every 2 minutes). Without that, use a {item:Dwarven Ring}.
Around the masts on this deck there are blind spots where the holes are hard to see. When you have spare time, check them and repair the holes, especially if you saw rats near the masts.
You receive 20 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins} and a {item:Pirates Surprise} inside a {item:Pirate Bag}. The achievements unlock like this:
20 Platinum Coins + Pirates Surprise per journey
If your world completes **50 journeys**, it gets +10% experience on some undead creatures for 5 days. Say {key:journeys} to {npc:Smaralda} to find out how many journeys the world has completed.
